tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gshin rje dmar po'i rlung sgrub kyi las byang bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi shor sang nyi ma khros pa'i bsnyen pa thems pa'i sngags pas gshin rje rlung sgrub kyi las sbyor nyams su len pa'i tshe/ bca' gzhi| sman/ rak+ta/ gtor mchod mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad gzhung ltar bshams la/ phrin las ngag bsgrigs 'di ltar nyams su blangs te/ nub dang po phyogs skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin/ mtshams gcod/ srung 'khor spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// dngos gzhi rgyun 'khyer ni/ e/ bdag dang 'gro kun 'di nas byang chub bar// rtsa brgyud bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// sangs rgyas chos tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// rab gus dad pas skyabs su nye bar mchi// lan gsum/ e/ mkha' khyab 'gro rnams 'khor ba las bsgral te// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sar 'god phyir// bdag ni 'jam dpal gshin rje rab bsgrubs nas// don gnyis mthar phyin byang chub mchog sems bskyed// lan gsum/ e/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams na// sangs rgyas kun 'dus 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// dad pa rab kyis gus btud gsol 'debs na// sngags 'chang bdag la dbang bskur byin phob cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka ā we sha ya a aḥ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ| nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes lan gsum gyis mchod pa dang sman rak+ta gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ lha bskyed ni/ e/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin chos// gnyis bsdus ngo bo stong pa'i ngang nyid las// phyi snod drag po e yi gzhal yas khang*// chos dbyings khyab bdal bskal me chu rlung 'khrugs// dur khrod rab 'bar rngam pa'i gzhal yas khang*// srid gsum yongs bsgral baṃ ro gcal du bkram// nang bcud skye 'gro phung khams skye mched bcas// glo bur bcos min gdod nas yongs grub pa'i// gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs sprin ltar gtibs// kun kyang gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs// rang rig gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug gsum// gsal ba'i ngo bo bdag dang gtor ma rten// skad cig gis rdzogs rdzus skyes gshin rje'i gshed// sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// rgyan med gcer bu dmar hreng sgreng ba'i stabs// spyan gsum dmar zlum 'khrugs shing sdang mig lta// mche ba rnam bzhi rno dkar bsgrad cing gtsigs// khro gnyer rab g.yo rdzi smin glog ltar 'khyug

/ral pa kham ser phyed ni gyen du brdzes// de'i phyed thur du sham zhing me stag 'phro// phyag g.yas lcags kyus dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugs// phyag g.yon gnam lcags tho chen rab 'bar bas/ dgra bgegs mgo lus don snod chom por gtong*// khro rgyal mi sdug stong gsum zas su za// srid gsum skom du 'thung zhing snang srid kun// yul du grub pas las kun thogs med sgrub// 'khor du ma gshin dregs pa sha za dang*// yi dwags 'dre srin 'byung po bye bas bskor// kun kyang bdag gi bka' nyan gsung sdod gyur// ces bsgom/ e e e/ 'og min chos dbyings rang bzhin dag pa'i klong*// gru gsum mthing nag drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas| |'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// drag po'i las bsgrub slad du da tshur byon// ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ e/ drag po chos dbyings gshin rje'i zhing khams nas// dur khrod gzhal yas baṃ chen gdan steng du// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i kiṃ kaṃ khro bo'i rgyal// dam tshig pa dang gnyis med brtan par bzhugs// ya mā ri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ e/ ya mān+ta ka khro rgyal gtso mchog dpal// gdod nas rang rig gsal stong char rdzogs kyang*// kun rdzob rten 'byung de yi rdzogs par shar// de ring gnyis mnyam rtogs la gus phyag 'tshal// ya mā ri na mo na ma ra raḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ e/ 'jam dpal kiṃ kaṃ khro rgyal 'khor bcas la// dmar chen ar+ghaṃ dbang po'i me tog dang*// sha chen spos dang zhun chen snang gsal dang*// mkhris chen dri chab sha rus zhal zas dang*// rdza rnga rkang gling dur khrod rol mor bcas// dgra bo'i phung khams skye mched 'byung ba'i tshogs// mchod par 'bul lo drag por bzhes su gsol// oṃ ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shā na ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/

gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes mchod/ e/ shor sang nyi ma khros pa'i lha tshogs la// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta// rgyu rkyen kun rdzogs dmar chen rak+ta dang*// 'bru nag sha rus ba liṃ che brjid rngam| |sbyor sgrol dug lnga dug gsum mchod par 'bul// oṃ ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta/ maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ ma hā pū dza kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ gtor mar sha zan sman rak+ta bran/ yang zlog gi drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma kiṃ kaṃ sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ma hā ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ nyer gcig gam bdun gyis phul la/ hoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po shor sang nyi ma khros pa/ 'jigs byed kiṃ kaṃ dmar nag gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ sman raka gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa/ mgo dang don snying*/ phung khams skye mched 'byung ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa zhal du bstab bo bzhes shig /rol cig /kha raṃ khā hi/ tshims zhing dgyes nas dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smod pa/ ban sngags kyi dkor la 'bag pa/ dben ri gnyan po 'joms pa/ rgyu 'bras bslu med khyad du gsod pa/ mi dge ba bcu dang mtshams med lnga la spyod pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bsdo ba/ yi dam dang chos skyong srung ma la smod cing brnyas pa/ bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i bar gcod byed pa/ mched la mkhu ba/ dam la ldog pa/ dam tshig can la gnod pa byed pa/ khyad par sngags 'chang bdag gis ma lan ma nyes ma yo bar/ bdag la do bsdo ba phod btsugs pa/ mi nga la lha med zer ba/ lha khyod la mthu med zer ba/ mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog par byed pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams ming yi ger bris shing gzugs liṅgar bkod pa 'di/

mi tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs/ nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ skye shi gnyis la khong ma g.yor/ las dang las kyi rnam par shes pa la bsnyad ma 'dogs/ lo dang zla bar ma 'gor/ zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar da lta nyid du khug cig /sod cig /gnon cig /drag po mngon spyod kyi phrin las da lta nyid du grub par mdzod cig /ces 'dod don gsol/ e/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// drag po chos dbyings gshin rje'i zhing khams nas// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng na// 'jam dpal shor sang nyi ma khros pa'i sku// kiṃ kaṃ dmar nag dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// ral pa gyen brdzes lhag ma thur du sham// spyan gsum dmar zlum 'khrugs shing sdang mig g.yo// mche ba zangs yag rno dbal ngar ldan gtsigs// smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas lcags kyus dgra bgegs bla srog 'gugs// g.yon pa tho bas dgra bgegs bla tshe 'gugs// zhabs gnyis rab bsgrad dgra bgegs gdan la bzhengs| |sku ni mi sdug rab 'jigs srin po'i tshul// gsung ni gzhom med drag po'i gad rgyangs sgrog /thugs ni rab zhi snying rjes 'gro kun sgrol// 'khor du ma gshin dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// gtum rngam khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka mañju shrī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab rkyang gi bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzla'o/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ dang e'i mthar bsnyen sngags kyis g.yas su bskor bar bsams la bzlas/ de nas mdun bskyed brub khung la dmigs te/ phaṭaḥ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing nag gcig mdun du 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dug dang zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom nag po zur gsum pa/

bang rim gsum dang ldan pa/ phyi nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ nang du gti mug gi mun pa 'thib pa/ zur gsum la 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba/ 'og na nga rgyal gyi brag ri nyil zhing phrag dog gi rlung nag 'tshubs pa/ steng na mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ser 'bab pa/ kha khyer la drag po'i rtsang rnams las gshin sha za srin po'i tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas gsod gcod kyi las la brtson pa/ nang du pho nya dregs pa bya dang gcan gzan mang po rgyu ba ngar sgra sgrog cing sha khrag srog dbugs la hab thob byed pa/ bdud dang gshin rje'i btson khang drag po thar pa med pa'i nang du nṛ las/ dmigs pa'i dgra bo nyams chung zhing rid pa/ mdog sngo ba mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ lag pa g.yon pas rang gi skra 'bal zhing*/ g.yas pas brang rdung ba/ mgon skyabs lha srung dang bral ba/ srog dbugs ma chad tsam mig nas mchi ma 'dzag cing kha nas 'o dod 'bod pa/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis non pa zhig tu gyur/ 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ dgra bo'i bla dang rnam shes khams gsum srid pa'i rtse mo man chad/ na raka dmyal khams yan chad gang du gnas kyang snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/ rgyab nas tho bas bcom ste khrid nas bdag gi mdun du slebs pa 'khor rnams kyis nam mkha' la phyar/ bar snang la g.yug /sa gzhi la brdabs pas kho'i khong pa'i nang gi tshe bcud nus mthu thams cad yar kha nas bskyugs te rang la thim/ kho sgye stong ltar gyur cing 'go ba'i lha lnga dang bral bas lus nag skem skem song nas brub khung nang gi liṅga la bstims shing*/ las gshin pho nya rnams kyis hab dir dir rang dbang med par khrid nas pho thams cad g.yas su bskor/ mo thams cad g.yon du bskor bas 'chor ba med par gyur par bsam/ dgu pa dgug gzhug brgya phrag gam nyer gcig sogs byas rjes kiṃ kaṃ gi bla 'gugs dang*/

khwa khwa mu kha sogs lha rnams dbye bar bya/ de rjes gong gi 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pas/ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza dgra bgegs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra bo'i bla sha ri ba ti 'gril 'gril/ sha ma ru ti thul thul/ myog myog /yed yed/ sha la ru ti khug khug /ling myog /ling sha /ling thuṃ/ tsa muṇ+ḍi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brgya phrag tsam bzla/ de rjes/ brub khung nang du dgra bo dngos su gsal ba'i kho rang gi lhan cig skyes pa'i lha de sbrul dkar po zhig tu gyur nas sna bug g.yas nas thon/ kho rang gi bdud du bab nas spyi bo nas tshangs pa'i bu ga nas yar 'jib snying rtsa yan chad drangs/ kho rang gi lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre de sbrul nag po zhig tu gyur nas sna bug g.yon nas thon/ kho rang gi gshed du bab nas gsang gnas nas 'jib mchin mkhris man chad drangs/ sbrul dkar nag gnyis 'dzing zhing 'thab ste/ kho'i snying khrag za bar kha ma mthun nas/ sbrul dkar pos kho'i gzhogs g.yas dang*/ nag pos g.yon du 'khril nas mjug ma gnyis dam por 'chor ba med par mdud/ sbrul gyi mgo gnyis kho'i spyi gtsug tu mdud pa byas nas lus la 'khyud nas klad khung g.yas g.yon nas kha gdangs shing bsgrad pa/ kho'i spyi gtsug tu rdo rje rgya gram rwa rnam par gdengs pa g.yon du khyi li li 'khor bas klad khrag bcom/ tshangs pa'i gtsug thag bcad/ mgo 'khor/ khrag tu skyug /mgrin pa'i khrag rtsa bcad/ lte ba'i srid rtsa bcad/ dran med du brgyal| lus sems phral/ snying gi srog rtsa bcad/ tshe'i 'du byed bskums/ klad khrag /mgrin khrag /lte khrag /snying khrag thams cad sbrul gnyis kyis 'jibs nas sbrul gnyis je che la song nas stobs dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ya ma kiṃ kaṃ dgra bgegs thuṃ ril nṛ myog myog sgribs/ dgra bo'i wāka s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ bhig nan/ dgra bo thuṃ/ de'i sham bur byur brub 'di la re sham re sham zer ba'ang 'dug

/bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la/ halta halta/ hūm̐ sa ma ya sgribs hriṃ dgra bo s+t+waṃ bha ya rak+ṣa nan/ hūm̐ ham̐'u/ laṃ laṃ/ hūm̐ laṃ/ thuṃ laṃ/ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig /ces gzhung sngags la 'bad/ gzhung sngags brgya rtsa re song ba dang*/ lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan brub/ ces pa de nas/ dgra bgegs sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya nan/ zhes pa'i bar dmod mo liṅga'i mthar bris pa de nyid tshar gsum re brjod cing thal mo brdab/ slar gzhung sngags la 'bad/ gzhung sngags dang dmod mo bzla zhing thun la sngags/ thun drug gam bzhir gtor mar sha zan dang sman raka bran/ liṅga la dmigs pa'i dgug gzhug drag po nyer gcig gam dgu sogs byas pa'i dgug gzhug tha ma'i tshe dgra bo bkug pa gtor ma la bstim/ gtor ma yang zlog drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka mañju shrī ha na ha na i daṃ ba ling+ta/ pañca a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ go ro tsa na/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ pañca skan+dha/ dhā tu kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags la lan bdun gyis gtor ma phu+ul nas/ e/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas// thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya/ sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten dmag tu sbran// chos dbyings drag po e yi zhing khams nas// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na// 'jam dpal gshin rje shor sang nyi ma khros// kiṃ kaṃ dmar nag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskul// drag po'i skur bzhengs mngon spyod dus la bab// 'di nas lho phyogs ri rab chen po'i rmang*// rim bdun sa 'og rgya mtsho'i gling bar na// lcags mkhar bcu bdun mnga' bdag skye 'gro'i gshed// las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas thugs dam bskul// phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil yangs na// bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i srung ma'i tshogs// snang srid dregs pa'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskul// drag po'i phrin las gnyan po'i dus la bab// sngags 'chang bdag gis ma lan ma nyes par// dgra dang bgegs kyi rnam par 'tshe ba la// gzu dang dpang gsol drag po'i mthu dpung bskyed// nyes byed gzugs ling ming du btab pa 'di// lo zlar ma 'gor zhag dang za mar sgrol// bla rkun jag pa'i tshogs rnams las la 'gyed/ */dgra bo'i bla tshe srog dbugs myur du khug

/lha dang phrol la gsod pa'i gshed dang sprod// lus sems phrol la sha khrag zhal du thob// bsad rtags srog snying dmar po khyer la shog /dgra bo'i tshe srog lus dbang rlung rta dang*// dpal 'byor phun tshogs mnga' thang thal bar rlogs// bla sems nus mthu sde dpung rnam par chings// brgyal reng smyo 'bog than dang ltas ngan phob// rtag tu thar pa med pa'i gnas su chug /mtha' med rgya mtsho'i steng du non la shog /'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha dang lto bar chug /drel rta rkang gsum myur mgyogs 'phong la skyon// bla 'dzin ru dar zing ba stag mgo dang*// a ba glang mgo gsod byed lag tu sprod// chu srin ka la sha yi gre bar chug /bye ma la dgu'i pha mthar bskyal nas kyang*// ri rab chen po'i 'og tu non la shog /nam zhig byang chub mchog sems ma skyes bar// mnan pa yin gyi ldang du med par gyis// dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dus la bab kyi bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// thugs dam dus 'dir ma g.yel sa ma ya hoḥ zhes bskul zhing*/ kiṃ kaṃ gi bla 'gugs dang*/ khwa khwa mu kha'i lha dbye bya/ thun 'go rnams su bla 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i bla 'gugs sngags sum brgya yan chad re bzlas rjes/ slar sbrul dkar nag gi dmigs pa dang bcas gzhung sngags la 'bad/ de ltar bsgrubs pas bla 'gugs khug pa'i rtags gsal zhing nges par byung rjes liṅga tshur phyung la/ lha dbye'i rdzas dud yang zlog nas bshad pa ltar bdug /slar brub khung du bcug la sngags ni/ oṃ ya ma kiṃ kaṃ dgra bgegs thuṃ ril nṛ myog myog sgribs/ dgra bo'i wāka s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ bhig nan/ dgra bo thuṃ/ de'i sham bur byur brub/ bhi ṣa tsakra ha la ha la/ halta halta/ hūm̐ sa ma ya sgribs hriṃ dgra bo s+t+waṃ bha ya rak+ṣa nan| hūm̐ ham̐'u/ laṃ laṃ/ hūm̐ laṃ/ thuṃ laṃ/ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig /tad+ya thā/ du shan du shan/

rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ dgra bo'i snying rtsa/ srog rtsa/ khrag rtsa la 'dus 'dus/ dgra bo'i snying rtsa/ srog rtsa/ khrag rtsa la chod chod/ mā ra ya rbad sod/ ces bsad sngags btags la bzla/ thun la'ang sngags/ thun drug tu dgug 'dren dgu re tsam gyi mthar gtor bsngos/ bstod bskul/ bla 'gugs dang lha dbye rnams byas rjes brub khung du thun 'phang zhing*/ thun rnams mtshon cha dang*/ thog ser/ than ltas/ nad ngan/ dug sna tshogs su gyur pa'i char pa bab pas dgra bo'i lus thams cad tshal pa tshal pa/ dum bu dum bur gtubs te/ las byed pho nya sha za yi dwags rnams kyis sha dum bu khrag thigs pa tsam yang ma lus par hab di ri ri zos par bsams la/ gzhung sngags la bsad sngags sbrel ba dgra bo'i lo grangs su 'gro tshad kyi sngags grangs bzla zhing thun brab/ mjug tu gong gi dmod mo lan gsum re bya zhing thal mo lan bdun bdun brdab/ slar thun 'gor 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i bla 'gugs sngags brgya phrag tsam bzlas/ de rjes sbrul dkar nag gi dmigs pa dang bcas gzhung sngags la bsad sngags btags shing sngags brgya phrag re song ba dang dmod mo dang thal mo brdab/ thun rgyag dus sbrul dkar nag gi dmigs pa mi bsgom par bshad ma thag pa'i thun 'phen pa'i dmigs pa de ga bsgom/ thun mi 'phen pa'i dus sbrul dkar nag gi dmigs pa yang yang gsal gdab pa gal che/ sgrub pa'i ring brub khung steng gi gtor ma stod bdag bskyed lta bu'i gshin rje la 'khor ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ smad dgra bo'i sha khrag 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor sgom pa gal che/ de ltar bsgrubs pas bsad rtags dang*/ mnan bcing dang*/ rgyal kha thob pa'i rtags nges pa brtan po lan 'ga' yar mthong nas las la sbyar ba ni/ liṅga gzhung ltar byad chas byas pa sogs gang du gnon pa'i sar khyer nas/ dong brus zin pa dang*/ rang nyid gshin rje dmar po sngar ltar la/

phyag g.yas dgra sta dang g.yon lcags kyu thogs pa'i g.yas dgra sta sa gzhi la sngar sgrub rten gyi gri lcags de mnan pa'i dong du rdeg pa'i tshul byas la/ bsnun pas sa gzhi shag gis gas pa dum bu gnyis su red pa'i bar nas/ mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po sngo mer mthong ba'i klu bdud nag po chu srin gyi gdong can kha gnam sa tsam gdangs pa/ mig nyi zla tsam nyin mtshan med pa gsal ba/ mche ba gangs ri tsam gtsigs pa/ ljags glog dmar tsam 'khyugs pa/ de'i kha'i nang du 'phang bas dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad de'i kha nang du bstim gyis tshud par bsam/ mnan pa dong du bcug /dbye 'gugs gzhung sngags nyer gcig tsam bzla/ de'i tshe 'og gi sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad dga' zhing*/ sa bdag gi phru gu tham cad tsi di ri ri 'dug pa dgra bo bskal pa ma stong gi bar du 'chor ba dang thar ba med pa/ slar klu bdud chu srin de nyid kha 'thams nas nyi zla gzas bzung ba ltar mun pa nag rub kyis song nas thar med du song bar bsam/ sngar ltar sgrub rten gyi g.yag rnga de nyid kyis mnan pa'i steng du brdab cing sngags dang dmod pa brjod/ me chu go ldog dang gzir mnan 'dul sbyong gi bro sogs gzhung ltar bya/ slar nang du ldog nas gtor mar sha zan sman raka bran/ gtor bsngos bsdus pa zhig gtang rag tu phul/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ gtor mar bskyed pa'i lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu| gtor ma phyir spags sha zan dang sman raka sgron/ me mar btsugs/ gtor mar dgra bgegs dgug gzhug lan gsum byas la/ tha ma'i mjug tu gtor ma dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs pa gshin rje'i tshogs la dmag lto'i tshul du gong ltar gtor bsngos byas la dbul/ slar gtor ma gshin rje'i dmag tshogs go cha sra zhing mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa stong gsum gang ba/ ki sgra dang bso sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa dgra 'dul du chas la khad par bsams la/

sngar gyi bstod bskul byas nas gtor ma dgra phyogs sam/ lha 'dre drag po gnas pa'i sa phyogs su 'phang ba'i tshe gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams glog 'gyu ba ltar skad cig la dgra 'dul du song*/ than dang*/ ltas ngan/ nad mtshon/ dme 'khrug gi char phab| dgra bo'i snying nang du pho brang btab/ mnan cing bcing ba'i las byas/ sha zos/ khrag 'thung*/ dgra bo'i bdun rgyud tshun chad rtsad nas brlag par bsam/ nang du 'ongs nas dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab cing mtshams sgrub dang bsrung ba'i rim pa la 'bad/ lag len zhib cha mthong rgyud du'ang blta bar bya'o// rgyud chen pā la pa tra'i 'jings zab las/ ded dpon lha yi zla bas rab 'byin pa'i// shor sang nyi ma khros pa rin chen dbang*// sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa'i blo gros kyis// rgyal mtshan rtser bcangs de la gsol btab nas// blo dman sngags pa'i blo dang rab 'tsham pa'i// rlung sgrub las byang tshig nyung don bsdus 'di// rim gnyis gnad song rang lo zhe dgu la// lhag pa'i lha dang yang yang mjal ba'i tshe// dgyes bzhin gnang ba thob nas zin bris su// sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas su mgyogs par sbyar// 'di dges 'gro kun byang chub sar bsgral shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
